title: JuControler Tester harness
description: An independent, read-only Tester Harness. The Tester observes and reports test evidence; it is not the QA Harness and cannot accept, reject, or gate results.

role.description: Tester only. The QA Harness is a separate role with its own contract; a Tester instance must never carry role qa.

harnessId.description: Identifier of this bounded Harness instance, released after its event.

projectId.description: Project the Tester observes; must match a Project Registry entry.

permissions.description: Explicit read-only permissions. Every field is fixed; there is no writable variant.

filesystem.description: May read project files; must not create, modify, or delete them.

repository.description: May read Git history and state; must not commit, push, reset, or change refs.

dispatch.description: Must not dispatch, send to, or control agents, runtimes, or managed work.

verdict.description: Must not issue PASS / CHANGES / OWNER_REQUIRED; acceptance belongs to QA and independent Verification.
